passive.name: Martial Poise
passive.description: Enter a movement command while winding up Kalista's basic attack or Pierce to lunge a short distance when she launches her attack.

spells.name: Pierce
spells.description: Throw a fast moving spear that passes through enemies it kills.
spells.tooltip:
Kalista hurls a spear, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage to the first target hit. If this kills the target, the spear continues onward, carrying any Rend stacks to the next target hit.

Kalista can dash after using this Ability using Martial Poise.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Sentinel
spells.description:
Gain bonus damage when Kalista and her Oathsworn strike the same target.

Activate to send a soul to scout out the path, revealing the area in front of it.
spells.tooltip:
Passive: When Kalista and her Oathsworn both Attack the same target, she deals {{ maxhealthdamage*100 }}% max Health magic damage. This effect has a {{ pertargetcooldown }} second Cooldown per target and a cap of {{ maximummonsterdamage }} to non-champions.

Active: Kalista sends a ghost to patrol an area for three laps. Champions spotted are revealed for 4 seconds. This ability has 2 charges ({{ ammorechargetooltip }} second refresh).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Rend
spells.description: Attacks impale their targets with spears. Activate to rip the spears out, slowing and dealing escalating damage.
spells.tooltip:
Passive: Kalista's spears linger in their target for 4 seconds, stacking any number of times.

Active: Kalista rips the spears from nearby enemies, dealing {{ normaldamage }} plus {{ additionaldamage }} physical damage per spear beyond the first. Slows enemies hit by {{ totalslowamount }} for {{ slowduration }} seconds.

If this Ability kills at least one target, its Cooldown is refreshed and it refunds {{ manarefund }} Mana.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Fate's Call
spells.description: Kalista teleports the Oathsworn ally to herself. They gain the ability to dash toward a position, knocking enemy champions back.
spells.tooltip: Kalista puts her <keywordMajor>Oathsworn</keywordMajor> into Stasis and draws them to herself for up to 4 seconds. The <keywordMajor>Oathsworn</keywordMajor> can click to launch themselves, stopping at the first champion hit and <status>Knocking Back</status> all nearby enemies. If the <keywordMajor>Oathsworn</keywordMajor> hits a champion, they are placed at their maximum attack range from it.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

variants.name: Martial Poise
effects: Innate: Whenever Kalista inputs a movement command during her basic attack windup or the cast time of Pierce, she will dash a short distance in the direction of the inputted location.Kalista cannot dash while immobilized or grounded, and she will be knocked down by any immobilizing or polymorphing crowd control during the dash.

Martial Poise's dash range and speed details:
Dash range of basic attacks is modified by the tier of Kalista's Boots and the specific angle of the dash.
At a 0° angle towards the target, the minimum dash range is 140 / 153 / 166 / 175 (based on Boots Tier) units.
At a 90° angle, the maximum dash range is 240 / 263 / 280 / 300 (based on Boots Tier) units.
Dash range of Pierce is 300 units when dashing anywhere in the direction of the point of cast.
If the dash is inputted to a location that is away from Pierce's point of cast, the dash range is reduced based on the cast angle, with a minimum distance of 150 units if the inputted location is directly opposite to the point of cast.
Dash speed is increased based on the tier of Kalista's Boots, and is affected by her bonus attack speed as well as multiplicative movement speed modifiers she is under the effect of (including slows).

Innate - Oathsworn Bond: Kalista begins the game with an exclusive Black Spear that she can activate on an allied champion to force them to swear an oath with her. Once the oath has been sworn, the ally becomes her Oathsworn, causing Kalista to form a tether between her and them. While she and the ally bound as the Oathsworn are within tether range of each other, they can both interact with Soul-Mark and Fate's Call.

Kalista can purchase the Black Spear from the shop at no cost to obtain it again and, before 3 minutes of game time, may activate the item again on a different target to rebind and swear an oath with a new ally. See Black Spear for more details.

variants.name: Pierce
effects: If Pierce kills the target, the spear continues onward to transfer all of the target's Rend stacks to the next enemy it hits. This can repeat indefinitely until the spear reaches its maximum range.

variants.name: Sentinel
effects: Passive - Soul-Marked: While Kalista and her Oathsworn are tethered, their basic attacks and Pierce apply a Soul-Mark to the target hit for 4 seconds.
Active: Kalista summons a Sentinel that patrols back and forth on a path along the target direction, granting sight of its surroundings as it travels.
Kalista periodically stocks a Sentinel charge, up to a maximum of 2.
See Pets for more details about Sentinels.

variants.name: Rend
effects: Passive: Kalista's basic attacks on-hit and Pierce apply a stack of Rend to enemies for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits and stacking up to 254 times.

A nearby enemy with a Rend stack is required to cast this ability. Rend can be used during the dash of Martial Poise and the cast time of Pierce. In-flight spears and Pierce if in cast will be empowered to apply Rend's effects to their targets. These empowered spears can also trigger Rend's refund.

variants.name: Fate's Call
effects: Active: Kalista invokes her tether to retrieve and hold her Oathsworn for 4 seconds. Kalista cleanses the Oathsworn from all crowd control and renders them invulnerable and untargetable for the duration, and pulls them to her over 1 second.

While held, the Oathsworn is vanished and may select a target location to dash to with displacement immunity, ending Fate's Call's invocation and reappearing at the location. If the invocation ends without the Oathsworn selecting a target location, they will automatically do so at maximum range from Kalista's facing direction.
The Oathsworn must be within tether range to cast this ability, and is also silenced and unable to perform movement or attack commands while Fate's Call is in effect.

changes.title: E - Rend
changes.text: Total AD scaling on bonus damage per additional stack : (+ 20 / 25 / 30 / 35 / 40% AD) ⇒ (+ 20 / 27.5 / 35 / 42.5 / 50% AD)

changes.title: Passive - Martial Poise
changes.text: Dash Calculation Rebuilt : Trust us on this one.

changes.title: Passive - Martial Poise
changes.text: Base Attack Speed : Now properly referenced. This is a buff of around 8%.

changes.title: Passive - Martial Poise
changes.text: Attack Speed Factor : Influence of attack speed slows has been halved. Attack speed increases still have full influence.

changes.title: Passive - Martial Poise
changes.text: movement speed Multiplier : Multiplied by (1 - Slowed%) ⇒ Multiplied by (0.2% total movement speed + 0.28). This is typically close to 100% but now benefits from bonus movement speed and is more resilient to slows. The minimum multiplier is 48%.

changes.title: Passive - Martial Poise
changes.text: Dash Animation : Restored Kalista's dash animation when basic attacking

changes.title: Passive - Martial Pose
changes.text: Bugfix : Kalista now properly gains dash distance with basic Boots of Speed.

changes.title: E - Rend
changes.text: Physical Damage : 20/30/40/50/60 (+70% AD) (+20% AP) ⇒ 10/20/30/40/50 (+70% AD) (+20% AP) (Note: Per-stack damage unchanged.)

changes.title: Passive - Martial Poise
changes.text: You Can Run, But You Can’t Hide : Kalista’s basic attacks no longer miss if a target leaves vision.

changes.title: Passive - Martial Poise
changes.text: Damage Dealt On-Hit : 90% of total AD ⇒ 100% of total AD

changes.title: Passive - Oathsworn Bond
changes.text: Oathsworn Ceremony Duration : 12 seconds ⇒ 8 seconds (Note: This begins when Kalista activates her Black Spear.)

changes.title: Passive - Oathsworn Bond
changes.text: new Ride Together, Channel Together : Kalista is now forced to channel on the Black Spear while her Oathsworn is reviving

changes.title: General
changes.text: MULTI-TRACK DRIFTING: Fixed a bug where Kalista was able to attack multiple targets at the same time by switching targets during Passive - Martial Poise 's windup

changes.title: Q - Pierce
changes.text: REND TRANSFER BUGFIX: Fixed a bug where killing a target with Pierce did not transfer all of that target's Rend stacks to the next target it hits

changes.title: E - Rend
changes.text: DAMAGE RATIO BUGFIX: Kalista’s Rend now correctly scales with 60% of her AD. Each additional spear now scales with 19.8/23.748/27.498/31.248/34.998% of her AD

changes.title: W - Sentinel
changes.text: BONUS DAMAGE ON MARKED TARGETS: 5/7.5/10/12.5/15% of target's maximum health ⇒ 10/12/14/16/18% of target's maximum health

changes.title: W - Sentinel
changes.text: removed OATHSWORN EMPOWERMENT: removed OATHSWORN EMPOWERMENT Kalista no longer gains 5/10/15/20/25 attack damage while her Oathsworn is nearby

changes.title: E - Rend
changes.text: new WEAK GRIP: Rend now deals 50% damage to epic monsters
